annotations.title: Suggest a short daily play plan

description: Suggest a short play-and-learn plan for one day from the app's catalog: send the child's age in months (36-119 for ages 3-9), up to 8 interests such as "animals" or "piano" (English or Vietnamese) and the minutes available. Returns an ordered list of activities that fit the minutes, with a reason for each; the same inputs always give the same plan and `day` (1-7) varies it across a week. It starts where the app itself starts the day and flags activities where the app asks a grown-up to be nearby. A suggestion, not a prescription, with no developmental claims. Read-only; interests are matched against the catalog and never echoed or stored. Never send a child's name.

age_months.description: Child's age in months (12-216); the app's content covers 36-119 months (ages 3-9). Never send a name.

day.description: Day of the week 1-7. Changes which equally good activities are picked, so a week of plans varies. The same inputs always give the same plan.

interests.description: Up to 8 short interests such as "animals", "piano", "maze", "cars" (English or Vietnamese). Words that match no area are ignored. Never include names or personal details.

name: suggest_daily_plan

matched_interests.description: Catalog topics your interests matched (ids only; your words are not echoed).

age_bands.description: Age bands (3-4, 5-6, 7-9) the activity is made for.

id.description: Stable activity id, usable with get_activity and how_to_teach.

minutes_basis.description: computed = from reps x tempo; app-stated = a number the app states; estimate = a planning estimate, not a measurement.

needs_grown_up.description: True when the app's own notes ask a grown-up to be nearby or to join in.

source.description: Repo path the activity was read from.

title: Suggest a short daily play plan
